Scripts.OnClick: if InGlue() then self:GetParent():Hide() else HideParentPanel(self); end

Scripts.OnLoad: if InGlue() then self.portrait:SetTexture("Interface\\ICONS\\INV_Misc_QuestionMark") else SetPortraitToTexture(self.portrait, "Interface\\ICONS\\INV_Misc_QuestionMark") end

self.ButtonBottomBorder:SetAtlas("_UI-Frame-BtnBotTile", Const.TextureKit.IgnoreAtlasSize) self.BtnCornerLeft:SetAtlas("UI-Frame-BtnCornerLeft", Const.TextureKit.IgnoreAtlasSize) self.BtnCornerRight:SetAtlas("UI-Frame-BtnCornerRight", Const.TextureKit.IgnoreAtlasSize) if InGlue() then self.portrait:SetTexture("Interface\\ICONS\\INV_Misc_QuestionMark") else SetPortraitToTexture(self.portrait, "Interface\\ICONS\\INV_Misc_QuestionMark") end

-- inject mixin here because a ton of inherited frames overwrite onload and fixing that is pain MixinAndLoad(self:GetParent(), "ThreeSliceButtonMixin") MixinAndLoadScripts(self, "ButtonControllerMixin")

Scripts.OnSizeChanged: if not self.UpdateScale then return end -- this can be called before the frame even loads self:UpdateScale()

Scripts.OnAttributeChanged: if self.OnAttributeChanged then self:OnAttributeChanged(name, value) end

Scripts.OnMouseDown:
if self:IsEnabled() == 0 then return end
self.Left:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-SilverButtonLG-Left-Down") self.Middle:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-SilverButtonLG-Mid-Down") self.Right:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-SilverButtonLG-Right-Down")
if self.ContentsFrame then self.ContentsFrame:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", -2, -1) end
Scripts.OnMouseUp:
if self:IsEnabled() == 0 then return end
self.Left:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-SilverButtonLG-Left-Up") self.Middle:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-SilverButtonLG-Mid-Up") self.Right:SetTexture("Interface\\Buttons\\UI-SilverButtonLG-Right-Up")
if self.ContentsFrame then self.ContentsFrame:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", 0, 0) end

local instructionFont = self:GetAttribute("instruction-font") if instructionFont then self.Text.Instructions:SetFontObject(instructionFont) end

if self.Text then self.Text:SetSize(w, h) end

Scripts.OnLoad:
local atlas = self:GetAttribute("atlas") self:SetNormalAtlas(atlas) self:SetDisabledAtlas(atlas) self:SetHighlightAtlas(atlas) self:SetPushedAtlas(atlas)
self:GetPushedTexture():SetVertexColor(0.6, 0.6, 0.6) self:GetDisabledTexture():SetDesaturated(true)
